scope: Local Windows CPU Qwen3-0.6B API-checkpoint comparison, not the combined landing binary or GPU performance.

environment.build: Ninja Release; Vulkan OFF; BUILD_TESTING ON; llmx target; one compiler; identical flags in both arms

workload.order: Even pairs: base/off, cand/off, cand/on, base/on; odd pairs reverse that order. Every cell starts a fresh server.
workload.warmup_policy: Full 512-input/128-output request retained separately and excluded from timed comparisons by plan.
workload.off_condition: No health requests; the existing load tool boundary health calls are disabled equally in both conditions. Readiness uses /v1/live.
workload.client_recording: Both arms identically retain prompt hashes/token identities locally. No request text or token IDs are published here.
workload.round_policy: One timed round per concurrency level. Every round retained; no best-only selection.

retention.partner_disposition: Pair7 cand/off timed out under the original cap. Its successful base/off continuation remains retained and unpaired; no ratio uses an incomplete observation.

metric_units.output_tok_s: output tokens per wall-clock second, higher is better
metric_units.ttft_mean: client seconds to first token, lower is better
metric_units.tpot_mean: client seconds per output token after first, lower is better
metric_units.changes: 100*(candidate/base-1); paired mean and median, not ratios of marginal means
metric_units.phase_limitation: Observed serving metrics include queueing/concurrency and are not kernel pp/s or tg/s.

identity.incompleteness_reason: Missing interrupted cand/off cell30 observations; absence is not a token mismatch.

counters.scope: Observed aggregate counters and candidate per-request counts agree with fixed-workload bounds and are monotonic. Polling ends with load, so this is not a terminal exact-total assertion.

focused_native_validation.coverage: Lifecycle, exact retired prompt/published totals, demand/coalesced/stale samples, idle/cancel cleanup, bounded records and concurrency.

limitations: Inaccessible/new process CPU deltas are unknown, not zero; short-lived processes may be missed.
GPU engine percentages are per instance and not additive.
Sample intervals may overlap timed-level boundaries.
Interrupted cell30 retains raw monitoring but no completed timed-level interval; it is not silently scored or replaced.
monitoring.sample_policy: Every planned sample and activity flag retained; no activity-based exclusions, replacements or reruns.

local_evidence.meaning: Local sibling workspace only; raw traces/request identities are retained locally, not published.

preparation_failures: Local records retain initial builds with unknown Git revision (rebuilt both with clean matching identities), the initial wrapper self-test error (corrected before inference), and the unsupported-flag startup attempt (stopped before inference). None supply performance observations.
conclusion: No demonstrated slowdown outside the observed noise in this bounded Windows CPU run. No speedup or zero-overhead claim, and no strict sub-percent bound. Substantial contention and paired variation prevent resolving tiny overhead. Same-file code-layout noise was not isolated by a perturbed control.
